chapterInfo.content:
71
AWURADE, nnya me
1Wo AWURADE na madwane mabɛtoa woɔ,
m’anim rengu ase da biara da.
2Fa wo tenenee yi me, na gye me,
yɛ aso ma me, na gye me nkwa.
3 # Dwom 18.2; 31.2-3 Yɛ sɛ ɔbotan a mɛtena so maba hɔ daa.
Woahyɛ sɛ wɔnnye me nkwa,
na wone me botan ne me ho fasuo.
4Me Nyankopɔn, gye me firi ɔbɔnefoɔ nsam,
gye me omumuyɛfoɔ ne otirimuɔdenfoɔ nsam.
5Na wo, AWURADE, ne m’anidasoɔ,
deɛ mefiri me mmɔfraase mede me ho metoo ne soɔ.
6 # Dwom 22.10 Wo na mefiri yafunum mede m’akyiri metweree woɔ,
woyii me firii me na yam,
wo na mɛyi wo ayɛ daa.
7 # Dwom 4.3 Mayɛ nnipa bebree ani so anwanwadeɛ,
na wone me dwanekɔhyɛbea a ɛyɛ den.
8W’ayeyie ne w’anidie
bɛhyɛ m’anomu ma da mu nyinaa.
9 # Dwom 71.18 Nto me ntwene nkɔkoraaberɛ,
na sɛ m’ahoɔden sa a, nnya me.
10Na m’atamfoɔ ka me ho asɛm,
na wɔn a wɔtɛ me kra bom tu agyina
11ka sɛ: Onyankopɔn apa no;
monti no nkye no,
na obi nni hɔ a ɔbɛgye no.
12Onyankopɔn, mma me ne wo ntam nnware,
me Nyankopɔn, yɛ ntɛm bɛboa me.
13Me kra ho asɛmpɛfoɔ ani bɛwu na wɔayera,
ahohora ne nsopa bɛkata wɔn a
wɔpɛ me bɔne so.
14Na me deɛ, mɛtwɛn ara daa,
na mede bi maka w’ayeyie nyinaa ho.
15 # Dwom 71.8; 40.5 M’ano bɛka wo tenenee,
ɛbɛka wo nkwagyeɛ da mu nyinaa
a mennim ano.
16Mede AWURADE Nyankopɔn ahoɔdenneɛ bɛba abɛkae wo tenenee
a ɛyɛ wo nkutoo dea no.
17 # 1 Sa 7.12 Onyankopɔn, wo na wofiri me mmɔfraase kyerɛkyerɛɛ me,
na maka w’anwanwadeɛ no mabɛduru sɛsɛɛ.
18 # Dwom 71.9; Yes 46.4 Onyankopɔn, nkɔkoraaberɛ ne ɛdwono mu nso mpa me,
kɔsi sɛ mɛka wo tumi ho asɛm makyerɛ nkyirimma,
na maka wo mmaninyɛ makyerɛ wɔn a wɔbɛba nyinaa.
19 # Eks 15.11 Na, Onyankopɔn,
wo tenenee kɔ sorosoro,
wo a woayɛ ade akɛseɛ,
Onyankopɔn, hwan na ɔte sɛ woɔ?
20 # 1 Sa 2.6 Wo a woma yɛhunu amaneɛ bebree a ɛyɛ ya,
wobɛma yɛanya nkwa bio,
na woatwe yɛn
afiri asase akunu mu asane aba.
21Wobɛma me kɛseyɛ adɔ,
na woadane w’ani akyekyere me werɛ.
22Me nso mede bɛnta bɛyi wo ayɛ,
me Nyankopɔn, ne wo nokorɛ,
mede sankuten bɛto wo,
O Israel Hotefoɔ no, dwom.
23Meto ayeyie dwom ma wo a,
m’ano ne me kra
a woagye no no ho bɛsane no.
24Mede me tɛkyerɛma
nso bɛka wo tenenee ho asɛm daa,
ɛfiri sɛ wɔn a wɔpɛ me bɔne no ani awu,
na wɔn anim agu ase.

Wo AWURADE na madwane mabɛtoa woɔ,
m’anim rengu ase da biara da.
Fa wo tenenee yi me, na gye me,
yɛ aso ma me, na gye me nkwa.
Yɛ sɛ ɔbotan a mɛtena so maba hɔ daa.
Woahyɛ sɛ wɔnnye me nkwa,
na wone me botan ne me ho fasuo.
Me Nyankopɔn, gye me firi ɔbɔnefoɔ nsam,

deɛ mefiri me mmɔfraase mede me ho metoo ne soɔ.

woyii me firii me na yam,
wo na mɛyi wo ayɛ daa.

na wone me dwanekɔhyɛbea a ɛyɛ den.
W’ayeyie ne w’anidie
bɛhyɛ m’anomu ma da mu nyinaa.
Nto me ntwene nkɔkoraaberɛ,
na sɛ m’ahoɔden sa a, nnya me.
Na m’atamfoɔ ka me ho asɛm,
na wɔn a wɔtɛ me kra bom tu agyina
ka sɛ: Onyankopɔn apa no;
monti no nkye no,
na obi nni hɔ a ɔbɛgye no.
Onyankopɔn, mma me ne wo ntam nnware,
me Nyankopɔn, yɛ ntɛm bɛboa me.
Me kra ho asɛmpɛfoɔ ani bɛwu na wɔayera,

Na me deɛ, mɛtwɛn ara daa,

M’ano bɛka wo tenenee,

Onyankopɔn, wo na wofiri me mmɔfraase kyerɛkyerɛɛ me,
na maka w’anwanwadeɛ no mabɛduru sɛsɛɛ.
Onyankopɔn, nkɔkoraaberɛ ne ɛdwono mu nso mpa me,
kɔsi sɛ mɛka wo tumi ho asɛm makyerɛ nkyirimma,
na maka wo mmaninyɛ makyerɛ wɔn a wɔbɛba nyinaa.

wo tenenee kɔ sorosoro,
wo a woayɛ ade akɛseɛ,
Onyankopɔn, hwan na ɔte sɛ woɔ?
Wo a woma yɛhunu amaneɛ bebree a ɛyɛ ya,
wobɛma yɛanya nkwa bio,
na woatwe yɛn
afiri asase akunu mu asane aba.
Wobɛma me kɛseyɛ adɔ,
na woadane w’ani akyekyere me werɛ.
Me nso mede bɛnta bɛyi wo ayɛ,
me Nyankopɔn, ne wo nokorɛ,
mede sankuten bɛto wo,
O Israel Hotefoɔ no, dwom.
Meto ayeyie dwom ma wo a,
m’ano ne me kra
a woagye no no ho bɛsane no.
Mede me tɛkyerɛma

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
